# Keep legacy signature-column IDs aligned with the view switch

The accepted markup declares sig_uid_col, sig_keyid_col and sig_created_col; getCellText switches on those exact IDs. These legacy snake_case IDs coexist with camelCase signaturesPanel. Local naming guidance: preserve the markup-to-view identity when editing this tree and rename both ends if a rename is needed. This is not a rule to apply snake_case to new Thunderbird DOM IDs. The tree columns have localized labels, but their spoken output was not checked. This is static source and test-code inspection at the fixed accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending.

Scope: OpenPGP DOM naming.
